verzen.tekst: He who keeps the law multiplies offerings.
verzen.html: He who keeps the law multiplies offerings.

verzen.tekst: He who returns a kindness offers fine flour.
verzen.html: He who returns a kindness offers fine flour.

verzen.tekst: To depart from wickedness pleases the Lord.
verzen.html: To depart from wickedness pleases the Lord.

verzen.tekst: See that you don’t appear in the presence of the Lord empty.
verzen.html: See that you don’t appear in the presence of the Lord empty.

verzen.tekst: For all these things are done because of the commandment.
verzen.html: For all these things are done because of the commandment.

verzen.tekst: The offering of the righteous enriches the altar.
verzen.html: The offering of the righteous enriches the altar.

verzen.tekst: The sacrifice of a righteous man is acceptable.
verzen.html: The sacrifice of a righteous man is acceptable.

verzen.tekst: Glorify the Lord with generosity.
verzen.html: Glorify the Lord with generosity.

verzen.tekst: In every gift show a cheerful countenance,
verzen.html: In every gift show a cheerful countenance,

verzen.tekst: Give to the Most High according as he has given.
verzen.html: Give to the Most High according as he has given.

verzen.tekst: For the Lord repays,
verzen.html: For the Lord repays,

verzen.tekst: Don’t plan to bribe him with gifts, for he will not receive them.
verzen.html: Don’t plan to bribe him with gifts, for he will not receive them.

verzen.tekst: He won’t accept any person against a poor man.
verzen.html: He won’t accept any person against a poor man.

verzen.tekst: He will in no way despise the supplication of the fatherless
verzen.html: He will in no way despise the supplication of the fatherless

verzen.tekst: Don’t the tears of the widow run down her cheek?
verzen.html: Don’t the tears of the widow run down her cheek?

verzen.tekst: He who serves God according to his good pleasure will be accepted.
verzen.html: He who serves God according to his good pleasure will be accepted.

verzen.tekst: The prayer of the humble pierces the clouds.
verzen.html: The prayer of the humble pierces the clouds.

verzen.tekst: And the Lord will not be slack, neither will he be patient towards them,
verzen.html: And the Lord will not be slack, neither will he be patient towards them,

verzen.tekst: until he has rendered to every man according to his deeds,
verzen.html: until he has rendered to every man according to his deeds,

verzen.tekst: Mercy is as welcome in the time of his affliction,
